pages.text: The Akaishi Plant Cultivator $(4)fast-forwards seeds and stalks into crops$(0) — the seed stays in its slot and is $(bold)never consumed$(0), so one machine can farm forever.$(br2)$(bold)How to use:$(0) drop a seed into the input slot and feed it Akaishi Energy. Each grow takes 200 ticks at 10 energy/tick, with a 100k internal buffer.$(li)Wheat / Beetroot / Melon / Pumpkin Seeds → their crop$(li)Carrot, Potato → themselves$(li)Sugar Cane, Cactus, Bamboo, Cocoa Beans, Nether Wart → themselves$(li)Mushrooms, Crimson & Warped Fungus → themselves$(br2)Outputs only land in the output slot — never seeds. Hook up item pipes for a fully hands-off farm, or slot in upgrades to speed it up.

The Cultivator grows, the Pulverizer grinds, the Compressor presses — gather this chapter's machines for a fully automated farm. For crystal materials, revisit $(l:akaishi:crystal)Crystal & Essence$(/l).
